frames.frame: [主语+谓语前半], [declared/calculates/he says + 主语], [谓语后半]（主谓间插入报道）
frames.gloss: ……，某某说/计算称，……（报道动词插在主语和谓语之间）。
frames.notes: 插入报道分隔主谓，易断错主句。

examples.text: Unemployment cannot be brought down rapidly, declared one 1935 analysis, because the workforce is “unadaptable and untrained.
The average budget for a “major” kitchen overhaul in 2006, calculates Remodeling magazine, was a staggering $54,000; even a “minor” improvement cost on average $18,000.
And early identification, support and treatment for mental health issues, he says, are the best ways to keep them from turning into full-blown disorders.

frames.gloss: 有确凿证据/毫无证据表明……。
frames.notes: solid/no 反义槽，证据宣告框。

examples.text: So what you need to know is that there’s no evidence whatsoever to back these claims.
There’s solid evidence that there are huge differences in the effectiveness of teachers.

frames.frame: Get [a N], and it’s (the same) as if [S V]
frames.gloss: 假设碰上 X，效果就如同……（条件祈使+类比）。
frames.notes: 祈使+and 表条件；as if 类比结果。

examples.text: Get a bottom 1% teacher, and the effect is the same as if a child misses 40% of the school year.
Get a teacher from the top 20%, and it’s as if a child has gone to school for an extra month or two.

frames.gloss: 更像 A 而不是 B（感受/类比对比）。
frames.notes: more like 连读整体，勿拆 more+like。

examples.text: If you are at of impersonal and intimidating globalization, a young person’s family feels more like a friendly haven than an oppressive trap.
And perhaps parents are acting more like parents than in the recent past.

frames.frame: [A] or, [评注副词], [B]（or 后插评注）
frames.notes: or 后逗号夹评注副词，易读断并列。

examples.text: Yet the persistent question of " Why do I need that?"--or, perhaps more tellingly, "Why do you need to know that?"--dogs the steps of many new ventures.
There is also very little detail on who will provide the funds or, importantly, who is responsible for their provision.

candidates.notes: but to 表『除了』，易误读转折。

examples.text: School-leavers may moan, but they have little choice but to embrace university and the student debt that comes with it.

candidates.gloss: 否则/若不如此，就会……（隐含虚拟）。
candidates.notes: otherwise 承担虚拟条件接 would。

examples.text: Otherwise, it would be unable to grow from a seedling.

candidates.notes: that 从句用原形 be，易误当错句。

examples.text: It is important that scientists be seen as normal people asking and answering important questions.

candidates.gloss: 与其说是 A，不如说是 B。
candidates.notes: not so much A as B 的 less 版。

examples.text: America’s education system has become less a ladder of opportunity than a structure to transmit inequality from one generation to the next.

candidates.notes: pay 此处为『有回报』非付钱。

examples.text: Yet it still pays to go to university.

candidates.notes: whatever 后无动词直连主句。

examples.text: Whatever your talents, it is extraordinarily difficult to get a leading job in most fields without having been to university.

candidates.gloss: 在……的情形下，……（正式条件框）。

examples.text: In cases where sewage mud is used, expensive chemical fertilizer use can be avoided.

candidates.frame: There has never been a time when [S V]
candidates.gloss: 从未有过……的时候（否定式最高级）。
candidates.notes: never a time when 反说峰值。

examples.text: In fact, other recent studies have found there has never been a time in American history when so small a proportion of young people have sought or accepted leadership roles in local civic organizations.

candidates.gloss: 如此……的一个……（倒装形容词序）。
candidates.notes: so+形+a+名倒序，易误写成 a so 形 n。

examples.text: In fact, other recent studies have found there has never been a time in American history when so small a proportion of young people have sought or accepted leadership roles in local civic organizations.

candidates.frame: It’s simply not true that [S V]
candidates.notes: simply 强化驳斥，非让步语气。

examples.text: It’s simply not true that economic growth will surely make our world cleaner. [M] Clearly, richer societies are able to provide environmental improvements which lie well beyond the reach of poorer communities.

candidates.gloss: 我们受苦不是因为 A，而是因为 B（先否后立并行）。
candidates.notes: 分号重复谓语，否立并行结构。

examples.text: We aren’t suffering from a shortage of needed skills; we’re suffering from a lack of policy resolve.

candidates.frame: As if that were not enough, [主句]
candidates.gloss: 仿佛这还不够似的，……（负面递进加码）。
candidates.notes: 固定让步递进导入，were 用虚拟。

examples.text: As if that were not enough. a Brazilian C-130 Hercules military transport plane has remained stranded near the runway of Chile’s air base here since it crash-landed in 2014.

candidates.frame: When [S V]—and they do sometimes—[主句]
candidates.notes: and they do 中插助动词强调。

examples.text: When the birds forget to retrieve their food---and they do sometimes—a seedling has a chance to grow.

candidates.frame: This isn’t a battle between [A] and [B]
candidates.gloss: 这不是 A 与 B 之争（否定重定义）。
candidates.notes: 否定常识框架再重定义。

examples.text: This isn’t a battle between garment workers and greedy bosses.
